# EvTextarea

> A multi-line text input for collecting longer free-form content. It supports a character counter, validation, optional icons, a scrollbar, and the same interaction states as InputField.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:textarea` |
| Layer | Atom (`src/atoms`) |
| Import | `import { EvTextarea } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvTextarea>` or `<ev-textarea>` |
| Source | `src/atoms/textarea/EvTextarea.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner `<textarea class="ev-textarea__control">`, not the root |

## Example

```vue
<EvTextarea
  label="Catatan pengadaan"
  :maxlength="200"
  show-count
/>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Input**, frame `4680:4513` (Input Text Area). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to collect longer, multi-line text such as notes, descriptions, or comments.
- Use the character counter to communicate a length limit.
- Use validation text to guide correction inline.
- Use the scroll variant when content can exceed the visible area.
- Use the disabled state when the field is not editable.

### When not to use

- Don't use for short, single-line values  →  use InputField (`evoq-ui:input`).
- Don't use for choosing from a fixed set  →  use InputDropdown (`evoq-ui:input-dropdown`).
- Don't use for rich/formatted content  →  use InputRichEditor (`evoq-ui:rich-editor`).
- Don't hide the character limit until it is exceeded.

### Do

- Always pair the field with a visible Title/label.
- Show the character counter when a limit applies.
- Show validation text close to the field, on error.
- Allow vertical resize/scroll for long content.

### Don't

- Rely on placeholder alone as the label.
- Use red borders without an explanatory message.
- Let content overflow without a scrollbar.
- Disable a field without making the reason clear.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvTextarea`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner `<textarea class="ev-textarea__control">`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:textarea` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
